The overarching aim of the project is to strengthen Costa Ricaâ€™s climate transparency system through the enhancement of SINAMECC, thereby enabling more effective climate action planning, monitoring, reporting, and policy implementation. This CBIT project is designed to generate global environmental and adaptation benefits that would not have been realized without GEF support. It strengthens national capacities to accurately track, report, and verify climate data, thereby ensuring compliance with the Enhanced Transparency Framework (ETF) under the Paris Agreement. By establishing a robust transparency platform, the project enables Costa Rica to better monitor its greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, assess mitigation actions, and identify adaptation needs more effectively. This initiative plays a critical role in supporting evidence-based policy steering on climate action. Rather than focusing on the initial integration of climate considerations into national policy—which has already been achieved—this project enhances the ability of national institutions to adjust and refine climate-related decisions based on up-to-date, high-quality information. Without GEF support, Costa Rica would lack the technical expertise, institutional capacity, and resources needed to implement and sustain these comprehensive transparency platforms. The additionality of this project lies in its capacity to elevate national efforts, enabling the country to contribute more effectively to global climate goals and improving the accuracy of its international reporting. These benefits are essential for advancing global environmental stewardship and strengthening the adaptive governance needed to guide climate action in a dynamic and uncertain future.
